intentions.title: Serve every uploaded image at the right size/format automatically, without per-asset manual export work
intentions.evidence: renditions.ex generates 4 WoodWing-style delivery presets (thumb/preview/hero/og) lazily on first request or eagerly post-upload via processing.ex; og preset is a fixed 1200x630 crop for share cards with zero per-asset lookup needed.

intentions.title: Keep image rendering swappable across OS/deploy targets so the same rendition contract works on macOS/Linux/Docker (libvips) and Windows (ImageMagick CLI) with no NIF dependency
intentions.evidence: image_backend.ex behaviour with impl/0 selecting Vix (default_impl for non-win32) vs Magick (win32) or explicit config override; image_backend/vix.ex and image_backend/magick.ex implement the same render/4 + available?/0 callbacks and produce equivalent aspect-fit / crop / watermark output.

intentions.title: Never falsely report a media asset as ready when its renditions are missing
intentions.evidence: processing.ex: generate_all/2 returns {:error, :all_renditions_failed} distinct from :ok-when-nothing-to-render; process/1 only sets status "ready" when Renditions.generate_all succeeds, else "failed" + media.processing_failed event, so serve_rendition never 404s against a falsely-ready asset.

intentions.title: Extract image dimensions without requiring a heavyweight image library, so probing stays available in every environment
intentions.evidence: probe.ex parses PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP headers via raw binary pattern matching (IHDR chunk, JPEG SOF markers, WEBP VP8/VP8X/VP8L variants) independent of libvips/Image, explicitly so probing works even where renditions can't run.

intentions.title: Support editorial watermarking (draft/editorial profiles) consistently across rendition backends and cache watermarked variants separately from clean ones
intentions.evidence: renditions.ex cache_relative/4 appends a `.wm-{profile}` suffix to cache paths; both Vix and Magick backends implement matching centered semi-transparent text watermark logic (DRAFT / EDITORIAL USE ONLY) sized relative to the rendition bounding box.

intentions.title: Give media a clean layered architecture (storage -> processing -> delivery) with strict one-directional dependencies so governance, transforms, and CDN concerns don't tangle
intentions.evidence: storage.ex moduledoc: 'BOTTOM media layer... Nothing here calls up into media-processing or media-delivery'; delivery.ex moduledoc: 'TOP media layer: depends downward on media-storage and media-processing... nothing in those lower layers may call up into it'; both are façade context modules re-exporting focused submodules (Access, Checkout, Collections, Relations, Share, SignedUrl / Urls, Cdn, AssetResponse, Events).

intentions.title: Cleanly skip non-raster image formats (SVG/TIFF/ICO/AVIF/HEIC) instead of erroring, since no rendition backend can decode them
intentions.evidence: renditions.ex renderable?/1 gates on @rendition_mime_types (png/jpeg/gif/webp) matching Probe's supported set; comment explains other image/* mimes are accepted on upload but treated as 'no rendition' rather than raising Image.Error, so original serving is unaffected.
